name: Ochre
description: The primordial god of life. Often taking the form of an ochre dragon, or a green haired elf.

features.name: Ancient Presence
features.description: The ancient god of life is always present in the area, and can be sensed by any creature with the ability to sense the presence of gods.

reactions.name: Ancient Ward
reactions.description: The ancient god of life can create a ward around itself or another creature, protecting them from harm.

reactions.name: Ancient Blessing
reactions.description: The ancient god of life can bless itself or another creature, granting them a blessing.

reactions.name: Ancient Curse
reactions.description: The ancient god of life can curse itself or another creature, cursing them with a curse.

reactions.name: Ancient Summon
reactions.description: The ancient god of life can summon itself or another creature, summoning them to the area.

reactions.name: Ancient Enchant
reactions.description: The ancient god of life can enchant itself or another creature, enchanting them with a spell.

legendary_actions.name: Ancient Strike
legendary_actions.description: The ancient god of life can strike itself or another creature, dealing damage and stunning them.

legendary_actions.name: Ancient Heal
legendary_actions.description: The ancient god of life can heal itself or another creature, healing them for a amount of hit points.

legendary_actions.name: Ancient Bless
legendary_actions.description: The ancient god of life can bless itself or another creature, granting them a blessing.

legendary_actions.name: Ancient Curse
legendary_actions.description: The ancient god of life can curse itself or another creature, cursing them with a curse.

legendary_actions.name: Ancient Summon
legendary_actions.description: The ancient god of life can summon itself or another creature, summoning them to the area.

legendary_actions.name: Ancient Enchant
legendary_actions.description: The ancient god of life can enchant itself or another creature, enchanting them with a spell.

notes: Ochre is a powerful god, and is not easily defeated. It is best to avoid it if possible, and to seek out its blessings if you can.

name: Ash Hound
description: A lean beast with smoldering fur.

features.name: Ember Trail
features.description: Leaves burning ground where it moves.
